name: Suzhou Hesheng Special Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Hesheng Special Material Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of composite materials for home appliances in China and internationally. It operates through Home Appliance Composite Materials; Investment and Commercial Factoring; and Artificial Intelligence and System Integration segments. The company offers PCM/VCM composite materials for use in refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Suzhou, China.
